<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Shin''' is the Supreme Kai of the Buu Saga. He is one of the Buu Saga fighters of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]] and one of your opponents in the World Tournament of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]].
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Shin can be drawn as a '''contender''' in the Otherworld Tournament. Each contender seat draws a random fighter from the Buu Saga cast. The draw is revealed once everybody accepts the rules, and you only face him if he reaches your bout: fights between two NPCs are decided automatically.

<!--T:9-->
His stats come from the tournament, not from the character: each contender draw has its own health, damage and AI tier. By default they range from 238,000 health, 9,900 melee damage and 8,840 ki damage (Smart AI) to 612,500 health, 25,800 melee damage and 23,460 ki damage (Elite AI), and contenders get 8% stronger for every round already played. Bouts end at knockout, so he isn't killed and drops nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:10-->

<!--T:11-->
Shin has a single form and doesn't transform. His AI tier comes from the tournament draw or, in the story, from your difficulty (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]).

<!--T:12-->
* '''Ki attacks:''' Ki Volley and Ki Blast, both yellow.
* '''Combos:''' none; he fights with plain melee.
* '''Mobility:''' he flies and backsteps away from your hits.

<!--T:13-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Kibito|Kibito]] and [[Special:MyLanguage/Videl|Videl]] fight with exactly the same kit.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:14-->

<!--T:15-->
[[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 8, ''Tournament: Shin'', is a World Tournament bout against Shin on the plains.
</translate>
